claims: Generation Z typically refers to those born between 1997 and 2012.
Generation Z grew up with smartphones and social media.
Generation Z ages range from 14 to 29 in 2026.
Generation Z will be 14–29 years old in 2026.
Alternative names for Generation Z are Zoomers, iGeneration, Post-Millennials, or Homeland Generation.
Generation Z is the first generation to grow up in a fully hyper-connected world.
Generation Z grew up in the post-9/11 era.
1997-2012 is the most commonly cited range for Generation Z birth years.
Pew Research Center cites 1997-2012 as the range for Generation Z.
